name: tif-talent-tracker-tests
description: Tests for TIF Talent Tracker. De koerer mod den rigtige kode i ../index.html og de rigtige regler i ../firestore.rules - ikke mod kopier.

scripts.test: npm run logik && npm run visning
scripts.logik: node logik/udtraek.mjs && node logik/test.mjs && node logik/stige.test.mjs && node logik/rang.test.mjs && node logik/backup.test.mjs && node logik/adminmaerke.test.mjs
scripts.visning: for f in visning/*.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.regler: cp ../storage.rules .lager.rules && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project tif-talent-tracker "for f in regler/*.test.mjs; do node \"\$f\" || exit 1; done"
